summary.text: Steve Bishop is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 17 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Bishop, listed by Ballotpedia as Steven Bishop, has represented District 17 since 2024 and is a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Steve Bishop attended Eastern Maine Community College, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as being a business owner.
Bishop, listed by Ballotpedia as Steven Bishop, took office in District 17 in 2024, succeeding Ronald B. Russell.
Russell is the Democratic candidate against him in the 2026 general election.
